evidence.reason: The scan calls path.stat(), which follows the symlink, then silently continues at 695-696 when the target is not a regular file. A symlinked drop-in directory that systemd traverses can therefore contain a dependency the scan never sees, while the scan still reports a complete observation. The finding does not require following the directory; marking such a traversable symlinked drop-in directory as incomplete is a routine correctness repair consistent with the existing no-follow policy.
